textTemplates.name: AccountingEmailBody
textTemplates.text:
Accounting Team:

I am attempting to create an item receipt that has {!Loop_Through_Selected_Rows.Product2.Name} on it. This product is missing the Purchasing Opportunity GL Account assignment for syncing to Intacct. I won't be able to create the item receipt until a Purchasing GL Account is added to the product. Please add the appropriate Purchasing GL account and reply to this email letting them know you've updated the product.


Thank you!

{!Loop_Through_Edited_Rows.Opportunity.Owner.Full_Name__c}
